purpose: Authenticate dormant native flow and qualify standalone source arithmetic without pressure/volume/energy closure
native_runtime: Actual authenticated getFlow, HH_Decomp, cell HH/curl/DEC and grid inverse/derivative bodies; actual identified loader/init/caller/consumer/GRN fragments; normalized explicit geometry; no full native simulation

ownership.cell: Stable explicit owner IDs with frozen deformation operator binding; fields in the declared order, no remap or reconstruction
ownership.ecm: Read-only qualified geometry GridBinding; all-value voltage inverse reused exactly; explicit C-order IDs, shape, bounds and spacing
ownership.pressure: No P_cells or osmotic PP read by getFlow. Cell HH uses rot_only=True; ECM scalar HH potential is discarded. No physical pressure solver or volume update

timing: Normal ECM updates precede getFlow, then deformation/concentration/voltage; voltage initialized before loop. Prior flow is consumed at current transport step. Fast loop never calls getFlow.

loader.cell_inverse: Not constructed by flow initialization; graph construction is behind deformation and forced-off td_deform
loader.grn: Separate current/(F*mean(c)*mean(z)) formula; enables flag; read/reinitialize config key spelling differs

units.cell_forcing: E*rho*gap_fraction/mu in 1/(m*s); gap parameter documented as dimensionless fraction

limitations: ECM absolute potential offset changes output at fixed E; not gauge-invariant electroosmosis
ECM uses voltage all-value inverse, not separately created all-flux lapENV_P_inv
HH rotational boundary source zeroing does not impose no-slip; source divergence reverses perimeter derivative signs
Cell HH is inherited actual curl/inverse/curl, not a guaranteed idempotent projector
Native graph initialization missing and source nonfinite/negative domains retained as evidence
ECM failure after early writes can leave partially updated state; standalone wrapper is stateless
GRN mean valence can be zero even with nonzero current/concentration; no denominator repair
reference: Independent frozen stdlib DEC/HH algebra plus new 80-digit flow forcing; frozen independent grid stencil/pivoted elimination plus new FD/HH loops. Manufactured refinements use independent analytic fields.

tolerances.refinement_auxiliary_scaling: Before the fixed 2e-11 output-field absolute tolerance, multiply divergence by h and divide HH potentials by h to compare all auxiliaries in native m3/s units.

scope_limits: No coupled-tissue, physical Stokes, pressure or no-slip validation claim
No geometry/remap, physical water volume, energy, ATP or ion-conservation evolution
No implicit conversion of ECM m3/s to transport m/s
No full native simulator or checkpoint integration
